issues.detail: The Hebrew 'עָשׂוּי אֶל כָּל הַבַּיִת סָבִיב סָבִיב' means 'made on all the house all around' (i.e., the carvings were made all around the house). The Chinese '一切家的四圍，四圍做工' awkwardly renders 'all the house' as '一切家' (all households) and 'made' as '做工' (doing work), which could mislead a reader into thinking the house itself is doing work rather than the carvings being made on it. The meaning is substantively altered.
